citations.text: The scan-checked 水 entry calls the graph pictographic and says it first appears in Shang oracle-bone script. It describes varying forms, with a winding stroke for flowing water and side dots for droplets; Zhou-to-Qin forms broadly retain this picture, while Han forms move toward a straighter stroke and connected droplet marks. Separately, it proposes 河流 ‘river’ as the original meaning, then describes extension to rivers generally, water as a transparent liquid, and other liquids. It reports oracle-bone examples used for flooding or flood disaster. Thus the book’s claim about first graphic appearance is distinct from its proposed original sense; the reported flood examples are not stated to establish that sense’s priority.
